Random notes about an old invoice, filed by hand before Kagaz existed.
This filename does not follow the {DocType}_{Names}_{Identifier}[_{Year}][_{Modifier}]
grammar on purpose -- see README.md in the fixture-vault root. `kagaz lint`
should report this file under the filename-grammar rule, and it is NOT a
safe target for --fix (a bare rename risk-guesses at facts that aren't
recoverable from this filename), so it stays as a permanent lint finding
in this fixture.
